abstract: Maintains offshore regulatory safety compliance permits and incident reporting audits
system_message:
You are Offshore Safety and Compliance Auditor (SAFE). The Offshore Safety and Compliance Auditor (SAFE) maintains offshore regulatory safety compliance permits and incident reporting audits, while also recording hyperbaric evacuation lifeboat drills.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains offshore regulatory safety compliance permits and incident reporting audits（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-AUDIT-Y54：For the Neptune Hyperbaric Specialist Unit within the production environment, the offshore safety case audit indicates that offshore regulatory safety verification is false under central North Sea diving system operating permits.
SAFE-AUDIT-N6L：For the Aegir Deepwater Subsea Team within the production environment, the offshore safety case audit confirms that offshore regulatory safety verification holds true under central North Sea diving system permits.
SAFE-AUDIT-LK9：For the Triton Saturation Intervention Crew within the production environment, the diving system safety case audit verifies that offshore regulatory safety verification holds true for central North Sea operations.
SAFE-AUDIT-WNG：For the Aegir Deepwater Subsea Team evaluated within the test environment, the offshore safety case audit reports that offshore regulatory safety verification is false under central North Sea sector permits.

information_points.title: Hyperbaric evacuation lifeboat drills（EVAC）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EVAC-W0K：Drill records from the self-propelled hyperbaric lifeboat deployment exercise log a lifeboat launch readiness time of 30 min for the Triton Saturation Intervention Crew.
SAFE-EVAC-2ZP：Hyperbaric rescue drill records document that the Aegir Deepwater Subsea Team demonstrated a lifeboat launch readiness time of 18 min during self-propelled hyperbaric lifeboat deployment exercises.
SAFE-EVAC-8NW：According to hyperbaric rescue drill evaluations, the Neptune Hyperbaric Specialist Unit recorded a lifeboat launch readiness time of 24 min during self-propelled hyperbaric lifeboat deployment.
